questions: Does the removal of the entire bottom row happen before or after the downward movement step at each time t?
If the bottom row is not completely filled, are blocks in the bottom row still allowed to move downward during the movement step?
When a block is removed because the bottom row was full, is it considered to “exist” at that exact time t for query purposes?
Are the time steps indexed starting from t=0 (initial state) or t=1 as the first update, and does a query with T=1 refer to the state after the first update or before it?
If multiple blocks would occupy the same cell after moving downward in the same step, is that situation possible, and if so, how is it resolved?
Is the grid height effectively infinite (i.e., blocks can fall arbitrarily far downward) or limited to 10^9 rows, and what happens if a block would move below row 1?
Are the coordinates (X_i, Y_i) given with Y=1 representing the bottom row, and does Y increase upward?
Can the value of W be larger than the number of distinct X_i values, and if so, does it affect the “entire bottom row” condition (i.e., must every column from 1 to W be occupied)?

inline_prompts: There is a grid with 10^9 rows and W columns. The cell at the x-th column from the left and the y-th row from the bottom is denoted by (x,y). There are N blocks. Each block is a 1 \times 1 square, and block i-th (1 \leq i \leq N) is located at cell (X_i,Y_i) at time 0. At times t=1,2,\dots,10^{100}, the blocks are moved according to the following rules: - If the entire bottom row is filled with blocks, then all blocks in the bottom row are removed. - For each remaining block, perform the following: - If the block is in the bottom row, or if there is a block in the cell immediately below it, do nothing. - Otherwise, move the block one cell downward. You are given Q queries. For the j-th query (1 \leq j \leq Q), answer whether block A_j exists at time T_j. Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: N W X_1 Y_1 X_2 Y_2 \vdots X_N Y_N Q T_1 A_1 T_2 A_2 \vdots T_Q A_Q Output Print Q lines. The i-th line should contain Yes if block A_i exists at time T_i, and No otherwise. Constraints - 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5 - 1 \leq W \leq N - 1 \leq X_i \leq W - 1 \leq Y_i \leq 10^9 - (X_i,Y_i) \neq (X_j,Y_j) if i \neq j. - 1 \leq Q \leq 2 \times 10^5 - 1 \leq T_j \leq 10^9 - 1 \leq A_j \leq N - All input values are integers.
